explication: This repository is a public container-image mirror project, but its checked-in contents are primarily configuration and contribution guidance; the README identifies the actual mirror backend as the separate ocimirror project. The documented user workflow is to rewrite an upstream image reference with a mirror prefix, then pull through the mirror. The tree also includes allowlist and image-change contribution guidance, automation configuration, and local-cache deployment documentation. No source excerpts were provided, so internal request handling and storage stages cannot be mapped reliably.
